channel.title: iFlipbook · Easy Things to Draw
channel.description: Easy things to draw with one finger and make move, from iflipbook.com.

item.title: Easy Penguin Drawing · Simple Doodle to Animate
item.description: A round penguin with a white belly. An easy thing to draw with one finger: a line or two, a dot for an eye and a dab of colour. Draw it, then draw it again a little different on the next page and make it move as a flipbook in iFlipbook.
